visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up of a woman's hands with purple manicured nails pulling apart a golden-brown chiffon cake to reveal a thick, creamy green pistachio filling inside. The setting is a brightly lit indoor space with white walls. (2) Cut to a medium shot of a young woman with glasses and pink hair clips holding a large Costco-branded box of six pistachio cakes. She is smiling and speaking to the camera in a domestic indoor setting. (3) She opens the box and displays the six cakes, which are sprinkled with powdered sugar and topped with a dollop of green cream. (4) The woman holds a single cake in its paper liner close to the camera to demonstrate its size, estimated at about 4 inches. (5) She briefly shows two small cat figurines (one white, one black) on small decorative plates. (6) Close-up shots follow as she peels back the paper liner of a cake and uses her fingers to point out the pistachio cream and powdered sugar topping. (7) She tears the cake open again to show the internal green cream texture. (8) She takes several large bites of the room-temperature cake, chewing thoughtfully and making facial expressions that suggest moderate satisfaction. (9) Transition to a different phase where she holds an air-fried, heated cake on a wooden plate. She tears it open, and the green filling appears more fluid and molten. (10) She eats the heated cake, expressing more excitement with her facial gestures and pointing to the cake to emphasize its improved texture. (11) Final medium shot where she holds the box again, discussing the price and her final thoughts, concluding with a laugh.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a female voice speaking in a high-pitched, excited Mandarin tone, immediately followed by the rustling of pastry paper as she pulls the cake apart. No BGM is present initially. (2) A light, upbeat acoustic guitar BGM enters with a moderate tempo (~105 BPM). The female speaker continues to describe the cake's appearance with frequent rising intonations. (3) A brief metallic/paper rustle occurs as the Costco box is opened. (4) The female voice maintains a high speech rate while discussing the size of the cakes. (5) A male voice briefly responds off-camera with a friendly tone, indicating a shared domestic environment. (6) Sounds of chewing and wet mouth movements (mastication) are audible as she tastes the cake. (7) A short cartoon 'ding' sound effect emphasizes a text reveal on screen. (8) The female voice shifts to a more analytical but still positive tone when describing the heated cake. (9) Both the female and male voices share a light laugh (low arousal crowd noise). (10) The video concludes with the female speaker laughing and wrapping up her commentary as the acoustic BGM fades out.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Product Intro -> Tasting (Unheated) -> Tasting (Heated) -> Final Verdict -> Price Disclosure.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a review of Costco's Pistachio Chiffon Cake. The creator demonstrates the product's physical characteristics and provides a dual-tasting experience comparing room temperature versus air-fried versions. The intent is to inform viewers that while the pistachio flavor is subtle and not punchy, the texture improves significantly when heated, though it may not satisfy hardcore pistachio fans.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator provides a critical review, stating she will not repurchase the item, which suggests an independent consumer review rather than a paid endorsement.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses typical social media editing styles with heavy use of variety-show subtitles and text overlays. The review is balanced, offering both praise for the texture when heated and criticism for the weak flavor profile.
